title: Without Settings Finance a user cannot see or open Credit Terms
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • Scenario: A user whose role has every Settings page except Finance tries to reach the Credit Terms page.
  • You are signed in as {User-A}, whose role has every Settings page except Finance.
    For example: {User-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S1-22 User, on a custom role ZZAUTOTEST S1-22 No Finance.
  • You have the Credit Terms page's web address, {Address-A}, copied earlier from an Admin's browser.
    For example: {Address-A} is the address shown in an Admin's browser while the Credit Terms page is open.
  • Starting screen: the Settings page.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Look at the Settings menu.
  2. Paste {Address-A} into the browser's address bar.
  3. Press Enter.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: there is no Finance group (or it has no items), so neither "Payment Methods" nor "Credit Terms" shows.
  • Step 2: the address is in the address bar.
  • Step 3: the Credit Terms page does not show; the app behaves as it does when this user opens the Payment Methods address (the same redirect or not-found page). No "New Credit Term" button is reachable.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list), story SV-11672 (Story 3, Create or edit a credit term), story SV-11680 (Story 11, Release day: what changes for existing users)

  • S1-N1: “If the user does not have the 'Settings → Finance' setting, they do not see "Credit Terms" under Settings, and opening the page's address directly does not show the page (same behavior as Payment Methods).”
  • S3-N1: “If the user does not have the 'Settings → Finance' setting, they cannot reach the page and do not see "New Credit Term".”
  • S11-N2: “Users without 'Settings → Finance' see no new Settings item; users without 'View and Manage AP/AR Data' see no new customer fields.”
  • Key Decisions, Permissions: “Viewing and using the Credit Terms page (the list, New Credit Term, Edit, Make Default, Deactivate, Reactivate, Delete) is governed by 'Settings → Finance', the same permission as Payment Methods.”

The build is not yet available to check this case against.
